findings.summary: The Fish script still iterates one line per completion, but format_completion now emits three lines (type, value, help) per item. The script therefore errors or yields no candidates for every command.

judge.reason: Fish script iterates per line while three lines per item are emitted, breaking all completion.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: format_completion replaces real newlines with a literal backslash-n in the value and help, and Fish never reverses this. Values containing newlines are inserted incorrectly, and descriptions show a literal \n.

judge.reason: Escaping newlines as literal \n without reversal in fish is plausible but not confirmed, and it is not the key bug.

findings.label: unsure

findings.summary: The test test_fish_multiline_help_complete only checks that \n appears in the help line. It never runs the Fish script, so it passes despite the parsing bug.

judge.reason: Test does not run the Fish script, so it misses the answer-key bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: The docstring says versionchanged:: 8.3, but CHANGES.rst lists the change under Unreleased, after 8.3.3, so the version number is probably wrong.

judge.reason: Version-number docstring nit is not a behavioral defect.

findings.label: false_alarm
